subject: a broad fan of powdered pigment

composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Spread mineral pigments into one broad gray-teal fan opening from the lower center. Fine ocher-gold grains gather only along its nearest edge, while the interior remains matte and softly varied. Keep the pigment physically convincing on warm paper, avoiding glitter or metallic effects. The upper field stays pale and quiet, creating restrained radiance from texture and simple directional shape. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
